rules.statement: A landowner is entitled to a cartway of necessity over the lands of adjoining owners if no other reasonable alternative route exists, and this should be granted even if the route sought is the best and nearest outlet.
rules.supporting_quote: "If the owner of the landlocked property must choose from which of a number of adjoining owners he shall demand a right of way, he will be entitled to obtain it from the owner whose property affords the most convenient oute. " (Hall and Kellaway : Ibid, p. 70)
